info.title: Nabat API
info.description: Crowd-sourced safety alerts. All endpoints require a bearer access token except the six POST /api/v1/auth/* routes that issue or reset one.

get.summary: What people say about whether a resolved report is really fixed, and what you said

put.summary: Say whether a resolved report is really fixed

patch.summary: The report's district says work has started
Close a report without a fix: a duplicate, not a real problem, not anyone's to fix
The report's district confirms it has received it

get.summary: The districts of Sofia that reports are routed to
Report categories — Call Sofia's groups and subcategories, with its codes
Sofia's districts compared on how they answered Call Sofia reports, from the archive
Open reports near a point in the same category group, in nabat and in Call Sofia
All reports, or one district's, in HOT, LONGEST_WAITING or NEWEST order
Active alerts within a radius, optionally filtered and newer than `since`

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A group code (every subcategory in it) or a subcategory code, from GET /api/v1/categories

get.summary: Reports in the district the caller acts for, newest first

FixCheckRequest.description: An answer to: is it really fixed?

FixCheckResponse.description: The answers on a report, with the caller's own

summary.description: The tally and what it adds up to

mine.description: The caller's own answer; null if they have not given one

FixCheckSummary.description: What people say about whether a resolved report is really fixed

partly.description: Answers saying it is partly fixed

notFixed.description: Answers saying it is not fixed

reporterVerdict.description: The reporter's own answer; null if they have not given one

outcome.description: What the answers add up to. DISPUTED if the reporter says not fixed, or more say not than say fixed

NotificationResponse.description: A user notification (vote event or milestone)

recipientId.description: ID of the user who receives this notification

relatedAlertId.description: Alert that triggered the notification; may be null

triggeredByUserId.description: User who caused the notification; may be null

read.description: Whether the notification has been read by the recipient

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the notification was created

RegisterRequest.description: Request body for creating a new user account

password.description: Password — at least 10 characters, including a letter and a digit, and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes

displayName.description: Public display name shown to other users

AuthResponse.description: Authentication tokens returned after a successful login or registration

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT access token — include in Authorization: Bearer header

refreshToken.description: Single-use refresh token used to obtain a new pair

user.description: Basic profile of the authenticated user

displayName.description: Display name shown to other users

emailVerified.description: Whether the email address has been verified

enabled.description: Whether the account may sign in — an admin can switch this off

districtCode.description: For a district official, the district they act for; null for every other role

CreateAlertRequest.description: Request body for reporting a problem in the city

description.example: Дълбока дупка в дясното платно, пред номер 12

categoryCode.description: Subcategory code from GET /api/v1/categories — Call Sofia's codes. A group code is refused.

photoUrl.description: URL of an uploaded photo for this alert

AlertResponse.description: Alert details returned by the API

categoryCode.description: Subcategory code; resolve the name and group with GET /api/v1/categories

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the alert was created

reportedBy.description: ID of the user who reported the alert

credibilityScore.description: Credibility score as computed by the voting service

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp when the alert was resolved; null if still active

photoUrl.description: URL of the uploaded photo, if any

districtCode.description: Code of the Sofia district the report is in; null only on reports older than districts

closedBy.description: Who closed the report — the district, the reporter, or a moderator. Null while open, and on reports closed before this was recorded

fixCheck.description: Whether people say a resolved report is really fixed. All zero and UNCHECKED on reports nobody has checked

VoteRequest.description: Request body for casting a vote on an alert

VoteResponse.description: The recorded vote and the resulting tallies

alertId.description: ID of the alert that was voted on

VoteStatsResponse.description: Aggregate vote statistics for an alert

credibilityScore.description: Credibility score as computed by the voting service

ChangeRoleRequest.description: Assigns a role to an account

districtCode.description: Required for DISTRICT_OFFICIAL, and only for it: the district the account acts for

enabled.description: False disables the account and invalidates its sessions immediately

code.description: Stable code, as carried by a report's districtCode

population.description: Estimated residents, from Yurukov's Call Sofia archive (2022) — for per-resident ratios, not a census

code.description: Group code; usable as the nearby `category` filter

color.description: Call Sofia's colour for the group

categories.description: The subcategories a report can be filed under, in display order

CategoryResponse.description: A category a report can be filed under

name.description: Name, as Call Sofia has it

hint.description: What it covers, in everyday words
hint.example: дупки, пропаднала настилка, шахти без капак

DistrictComparisonResponse.description: Districts compared over a period of Call Sofia's archive

archiveFrom.description: First filing date in the archive; null if no archive is imported

archiveTo.description: Last filing date in the archive — everything is as of this day

districts.description: One entry per district with reports in the period

DistrictOutcomesResponse.description: How one district handled its reports. "Answered" is the first final word to the citizen — a reply, a closure or a rejection — not a fix.

medianDaysToAnswer.description: Median days to the first answer, over answered reports; null if none

p90DaysToAnswer.description: Nine in ten answered reports were answered within this many days

dueIn30Days.description: Reports filed at least 30 days before the archive ends — the ones the 30-day deadline can be judged on

answeredOnly.description: Ended as „Получил уведомление“ — a reply, and nothing after it

stillOpen.description: No final answer when the archive was taken

UserVoteResponse.description: Indicates whether the current user has voted on an alert

hasVoted.description: true if the authenticated user has an active vote

voteType.description: The vote type, or null if hasVoted is false

SimilarCallSofiaReport.description: A report open in Call Sofia near the point

categoryCode.description: Category code — the same codes as nabat's

meters.description: Metres from the point asked about

SimilarReport.description: An open nabat report near the point

meters.description: Metres from the point asked about

SimilarReportsResponse.description: What might be the same problem, already reported

radiusMeters.description: How far around the point was searched

callSofia.description: Reports open in Call Sofia, nearest first; empty when Call Sofia's map is not being read

RankedReportsResponse.description: One page of the public list of reports

alerts.description: The reports on this page, in order

total.description: How many reports match in all, across every page

NearbyAlertsResponse.description: Active alerts near a point, capped at `limit`

count.description: Number of alerts in this response

truncated.description: True when the cap was reached and older matches were dropped. Narrow the radius or filter by type to see them.

UserPageResponse.description: One page of accounts, with the total so a caller knows there are more

bearerAuth.description: The access token from POST /api/v1/auth/login or /auth/refresh. Refresh tokens are rejected here: they carry a different token type and are only accepted by /auth/refresh.
